nextStoryContext: US-001 reconciled only the 11 CAM-536 spec-adjudicated pure-drift hunks. The subagent-orchestrator.md, handoff.schema.json, issues.schema.json, and orch-handoff.schema.json pairs are now byte-identical; the other persona/CLAUDE.md overlay-owned divergence remains intentionally untouched except for the template-bound generic guidance and the reviewer `it` restore specified here. The exact CLAUDE.md fidelity derivation currently yields 32 non-blank lines from main, all present verbatim in the template; its paragraph-granular exclusions keep the 0.x-demotion and recovery-runbook paragraphs out. All 15 story oracles passed through runBehavioralGate at Layer A, the full suite reported 6192 pass / 0 fail, check:all passed, and the embedded vendor map was regenerated and verified clean. Future overlay work must use this post-US-001 template base and must not reinterpret the known diff-alignment artifacts as new drift.
